svg.text: 15x10 ROOF, ONE RIB FROM BASE RING TO CROWN, DEVELOPED ELEVATION
Rib unrolled into its own vertical plane: horizontal = distance along the rib in plan, vertical = height. Colour and diagram = My, out-of-plane bending (Karamba local y), kNm.
Karamba 2 m model, design model D2. Diagram scale: 10.0 kNm = 1.5 m; colour full at half of that. Red = +My, blue = -My. Path length 10.77 m; start bar = most utilised bottom-band rib (68 %).
max utilisation along the rib 68 % of 12 MPa
max utilisation along the rib 60 % of 24 MPa
